column7: PurgeDeletedProjectsBefore hard-deleted the project but left its machine_identity_roles rows, and GetMachineRoleIDsAt's LEFT JOIN on projects read the missing project (NULL deleted_at) as live, so a machine kept a role at a purged project. The purge now deletes those rows in the same transaction, scoped to the still-eligible project IDs. The read-side JOIN hardening (treat a missing project as not live) is deferred: GetMachineRoleIDsAt and its verbatim copies are read-path permission lookups owned by OPT-READPATH-2.
